t: Lesson 4, Artifacts. Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
This is where Claude's work becomes something you can share.
Artifacts are finished pieces of work. Docs you can edit together, and export to Word or PDF.
Slide decks built from your content, that export to PowerPoint, designs like one-pagers and landing pages,
and dashboards, calculators, and small tools.
The quality of the output reflects the quality of the ask.
Name the deliverable and how big it is. Name the audience, and say what to cover in your brand's voice.
Then run the loop. Ask for the artifact, review it like an editor, highlight any part, and ask Claude to change just that spot.
Then share it or export it.
A few things to know. Artifacts start private, you choose when to share, people you share with sign into view,
and they're great for prototypes, not for production software.
Quick recap. Artifacts turn Claude's work into real deliverables you can edit, export, and share.
Your mission, turn one recurring report into a doc or deck artifact, and share it with a teammate.
Now your work ships. Next lesson, skills. Teach Claude to do it your way. Learn, build, ship with LetsVibeAI
